latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage and completed its one native Goal. The investigator package corrects the released plan’s main unsafe assumptions; I found four material completeness gaps and one minor wording issue.

Saved:

- [critique.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A6-01/control/stages/critic/critique.md)
- [source-map.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A6-01/control/stages/critic/source-map.json)
- [sources/index.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A6-01/control/stages/critic/sources/index.md)

The gaps cover headway-based service, daylight-saving time handling, SIRI version applicability, and GTFS-RT trip relationships. The minor issue clarifies that OTP’s PR includes a narrow feature-toggle unit test, but no load test. These findings are supported by the [GTFS Schedule reference](https://gtfs.org/documentation/schedule/reference/), [SIRI repository](https://github.com/TransmodelEcosystem/SIRI), and [OTP test commit](https://github.com/opentripplanner/OpenTripPlanner/commit/69ac485).

No product validation was run; proposed checks remain NOT_RUN. Native Goal status is directly observed as **complete** (thread ID `01a12405-708e-7960-aee8-6bb901d7a6e1`; 195,929 tokens; 470 seconds). Provider and method provenance were not exposed and are UNKNOWN.
